Preview:
From
StillNorthMedia
site:
"You may use any of our sounds freely, with no royalties, and no credit needs to be given (although it is always appreciated)."
And from
FreeFirearmsSFX
, the project that prompted Still North Media's inception:
"Our team holds CC0 NO RIGHTS RESERVED for this library. It may be used without royalty or credit (though we would love to hear how you've used our sounds) for any application, personal or professional. Have at it!"
See also these related submissions by the same team:
https://opengameart.org/content/the-free-firearm-sound-library
https://opengameart.org/content/medieval-sound-effects-weapon-textures
Please note that OGA is not affiliated with this project. We would encourage you to visit their site, but it is no longer available except via Archive.org (Thanks,
Internet Archive
!)
Big thanks to their
team
and all of their
Kickstarter supporters
for kicking off all that lead to this amazing content!
